{"diagnosis": "Trace shows TRAP: no progress max_addr=0x00000000 (FINGERPRINT 938a85fe28aa, VERDICT FAIL 0xdead) vs expected fetch progress through 256-word NOP mem. CONE_SLICE is empty so trace wins; excerpt line 583 `if (mem_do_prefetch && mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata)` parses as (prefetch&&rinst)||rdata, so instr-fetch-only never asserts mem_valid/mem_state<=1. Hence no mem_xfer/fetch and max_addr stuck at 0.",
"patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -581,7 +581,7 @@
 			case (mem_state)
 				0: begin
-					if (mem_do_prefetch && mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata) begin
+					if (mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata) begin
 						mem_valid <= !mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word;
 						mem_instr <= mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst;
 						mem_wstrb <= 0;
 						mem_state <= 1;",
"expected": "tohost PASS (not FAIL 0xdead), no TRAP: no progress, max_addr>0x00000000 showing fetch progress"}
